articles.headline: Trump claims deal to end Iran war near as Tehran says 'nothing' finalised
articles.summary: The US president says a "great settlement" to end the conflict has been reached. Iran says reports of a deal are "speculative".
articles._summary: US President Donald Trump has claimed an initial agreement aimed at ending the war with Iran is close after posting that he had cancelled strikes on the country. "We just made a great settlement of the war with Iran," he told reporters in the Oval Office on Thursday. Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei told state TV that reports of an agreement were "speculative" and "nothing has been finalised". Trump has made similar claims in the past that the two countries are close to reaching a deal to end the conflict. Hours before the announcement, Trump had declared he would hit Iran "very hard". The US and Israel launched wide-ranging strikes on Iran on 28 February. Iran responded by attacking Israel and US-allied states in the Gulf, and effectively closing the Strait of Hormuz - a key shipping route for the world's oil and liquefied natural gas.
articles._zh_headline: 特朗普声称结束伊朗战争的协议即将达成，但德黑兰表示“没有任何敲定”
articles._zh_summary: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在宣布取消对伊朗的袭击后声称，旨在结束与伊朗战争的初步协议即将达成。 “我们刚刚就与伊朗的战争达成了一项伟大的解决方案，”他周四在椭圆形办公室对记者说。伊朗外交部发言人埃斯梅尔·巴加伊 (Esmail Baghaei) 告诉国家电视台，有关协议的报道是“推测性的”，“一切尚未最终确定”。特朗普过去也曾发表过类似言论，称两国即将达成协议以结束冲突。在宣布这一消息的几个小时前，特朗普宣布他将“非常严厉”地打击伊朗。 2月28日，美国和以色列对伊朗发动了大范围打击。伊朗的回应是攻击以色列和美国在海湾的盟国，并有效关闭霍尔木兹海峡——世界石油和液化天然气的重要运输路线。

articles.headline: Flip flop or deliberate? - Unpacking Trump’s strategy on Iran
articles.summary: The BBC's Gary O'Donoghue looks at the US president's mixed messaging over the war and the questions it raises.
articles._summary: President Donald Trump cancelled strikes on Iran after earlier threatening that the US would strike the country on Thursday night. He cited negotiations for cancelling the strikes. The BBC's Gary O'Donoghue looks at Trump's mixed messaging over Iran and the questions it raises. The BBC spoke to voters in Maine on election day on who they want to challenge Republican Senator Susan Collins. Strong winds, intense rain and hailstones the size of golf balls pelted the city and the surrounding area on Monday. Nada Tawfik is at Delaney Hall, where protesters have clashed with police and authorities have imposed a curfew across a half-mile area surrounding the facility. An AI video of President Trump’s name being ripped off the front of the building has been seen by millions online. According to Nasa, the meteor released the equivalent to about 300 tons of TNT when it broke up.
articles._zh_headline: 随波逐流还是故意？ - 解读特朗普的伊朗战略
articles._zh_summary: 唐纳德·特朗普总统在早些时候威胁美国将在周四晚上袭击伊朗后取消了对伊朗的袭击。他引用了取消罢工的谈判。英国广播公司 (BBC) 的加里·奥多诺霍 (Gary O'Donoghue) 探讨了特朗普在伊朗问题上发出的复杂信息及其引发的问题。英国广播公司 (BBC) 在选举日与缅因州选民进行了交谈，讨论他们希望谁来挑战共和党参议员苏珊·柯林斯 (Susan Collins)。周一，强风、暴雨和高尔夫球大小的冰雹袭击了这座城市及周边地区。纳达·陶菲克 (Nada Tawfik) 在德莱尼大厅 (Delaney Hall)，抗议者与警察发生冲突，当局已在该设施周围半英里的区域实施宵禁。数百万人在网上观看了一段特朗普总统名字被从大楼正面撕下来的人工智能视频。据美国宇航局称，流星破裂时释放出相当于约 300 吨 TNT 的炸药。

articles.author: Badar Shaikh
articles.headline: 'Biggest Losers Aren't In Tehran:' Analyst Takes Aim At Trump Admin Over Iran Fallout
articles.summary: GasBuddy analyst Patrick De Haan criticizes Trump admin for Iran war effects still hurting Americans with higher costs.
articles._summary: GasBuddy analyst Patrick De Haan has criticized the President Donald Trump administration, saying that the effects of the Iran war were still negatively impacting Americans in the form of higher costs . In a post on X on Thursday, De Haan quoted a post by Trump’s Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent , who warned Iran that damages sustained by U.S. allies in the Gulf would be compensated by using Iranian funds. “Any tolls paid to the Persian Gulf Strait Authority will be offset by funds extracted from their accounts,” Bessent said, warning of deep financial consequences for Tehran. De Haan criticized Bessent’s comments. “101 days in, and the biggest losers aren’t in Tehran,” De Haan said, “they’re the people paying higher prices while there’s still no clear plan or objective.” He called comments about “offsetting tolls” as being “absurd,” saying the comments about tolls could “validate an illegitimate threat.”
articles._zh_headline: “最大的输家不在德黑兰：”分析师就伊朗问题将矛头指向特朗普政府
articles._zh_summary: GasBuddy 分析师帕特里克·德哈恩 (Patrick De Haan) 批评了唐纳德·特朗普总统政府，称伊朗战争的影响仍然以成本上升的形式对美国人产生负面影响。德哈恩周四在 X 上发表的一篇文章中引用了特朗普财政部长斯科特·贝森特的帖子，他警告伊朗，美国在海湾盟友遭受的损失将通过使用伊朗资金来补偿。贝森特说：“向波斯湾海峡管理局支付的任何通行费都将被从其账户中提取的资金所抵消。”他警告称，这将对德黑兰造成严重的财务后果。德哈恩批评了贝森特的言论。 “101天过去了，最大的输家不在德黑兰，”德哈恩说，“他们是那些在仍然没有明确计划或目标的情况下支付更高价格的人。”他称有关“抵消通行费”的评论是“荒谬的”，并表示有关通行费的评论可能“证实非法威胁”。

articles.headline: Deadly Sudan drone strike targets funeral procession
articles.summary: Rights groups accuse the RSF paramilitary group of killing civilians in el-Obeid, a city on the civil war's front line.
articles._summary: A drone strike on a funeral procession at a cemetery in the Sudanese city of el-Obeid has killed at least four people and injured several others, two rights groups, Sudan Doctors Network and Emergency Lawyers, have said. Both groups blame the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) for the attack. Emergency Lawyers said it was part of a series of drone strikes that started on Wednesday evening in which at least 23 people have died in all. El-Obeid, currently in the hands of the army, is a key battleground in Sudan's three-year civil war which began after the leaders of the army and RSF fell out over the future direction of the country. The fighting has created the world's worst humanitarian crisis with more than 11 million people forced from their homes and 28 million facing acute hunger. There are no reliable figures for the death toll, but it is thought to be at least 50,000.
articles._zh_headline: 苏丹致命无人机袭击送葬队伍
articles._zh_summary: 苏丹医生网络和紧急律师这两个人权组织表示，无人机袭击了苏丹奥贝德市一处墓地的送葬队伍，造成至少四人死亡，多人受伤。两个组织都将此次袭击归咎于准军事快速支援部队（RSF）。 Emergency Lawyers 表示，这是周三晚上开始的一系列无人机袭击的一部分，此次袭击总共造成至少 23 人死亡。目前由军队控制的奥贝德是苏丹三年内战的一个关键战场，这场内战是在军队和无国界部队领导人就国家未来方向发生争执后开始的。战斗造成了世界上最严重的人道主义危机，超过 1100 万人被迫离开家园，2800 万人面临严重饥饿。目前尚无可靠的死亡人数数字，但据信至少有 50,000 人。

articles.author: Daragh Thomas
articles.headline: A Good Idea? Retail Traders Are Selling Micron, Qualcomm, Broadcom To Rotate Into The Space X IPO
articles.summary: Elon Musk’s SpaceX hasn’t started trading yet, and it is already pulling cash out of the chip stocks retail traders spent the spring chasing.
articles._summary: Elon Musk’s SpaceX hasn’t started trading yet, and it is already pulling cash out of the chip stocks retail traders spent the spring chasing. The do-it-yourself crowd has been trimming semiconductor exposure and skipping dips elsewhere, according to Vanda Research. Some analysts read the selling as retail gathering dry powder for the SpaceX debut, expected Friday. Non-professional traders sold individual stocks for three straight days through Wednesday, the first such streak since March 2020, Vanda’s data show.
articles._zh_headline: 好主意吗？零售交易商正在抛售美光、高通、博通，以参与 Space X IPO
articles._zh_summary: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX 尚未开始交易，但它已经从散户交易员今年春季追逐的芯片股中提取现金。 Vanda Research 表示，DIY 人群一直在削减半导体投资，并跳过其他领域的下跌。一些分析师将这次抛售解读为散户为 SpaceX 预计周五的首次亮相收集干粉。 Vanda 的数据显示，截至周三，非专业交易员连续三天抛售个股，这是自 2020 年 3 月以来的首次连续出售个股。

articles.author: Chris Katje
articles.headline: Trump Phone Promised 'Made In America' — Teardown Shows It Was Designed In China
articles.summary: A teardown of the new phone from Trump Mobile shows the phone may have parts from China and be assembled in China.
articles._summary: • Micron Technology stock is trading at elevated levels. What’s next for MU stock? The Trump Organization previously got rid of its Made in America claims, using phrases like "Designed with American Values," "Proudly American" and "American Proud Design" to describe its T1 phone. A new teardown of the T1 phone by iFixit and NBC reveals the phone is nearly identical to the HTC U24 Pro, a smartphone made in China for the Taiwanese company.
articles._zh_headline: 特朗普手机承诺“美国制造”——拆解显示它是中国设计的
articles._zh_summary: • 美光科技股票交易价格处于高位。 MU股票的下一步是什么？特朗普集团此前放弃了“美国制造”的说法，使用“以美国价值观设计”、“美国自豪”和“美国自豪设计”等短语来描述其 T1 手机。 iFixit 和 NBC 对 T1 手机的最新拆解显示，这款手机与 HTC U24 Pro（为这家台湾公司在中国制造的智能手机）几乎一模一样。
